All11 layer/run/centre/table fields are locally generated3.0/4.0/5.0 synthetic
messages with illustrative constants and one explicit bitmap gap. They are not
real NOAA/ECMWF forecasts. Metadata/values and per-message hashes are captured in
REQUESTS-REFERENCE.json. Generation code belongs to this Apache-2.0 source project.
Surface100 usesPa and103 usesm per NOAA table4.5; label850hPa uses raw85000Pa.
